title: Past Experiences
summary: 一般过去时、旅行经历、活动和感受。
objectives: Describe past travel and daily events in order
Give a reason for a reaction or change of plans

vocabulary.example: I bought a souvenir at the market.

listening.title: A Weekend Away
listening.transcript: We arrived in Brighton on Friday and stayed for two nights. On Saturday we walked along the beach. We returned home on Sunday afternoon.

speaking.prompt: 用四句话讲一次短途旅行，按到达、活动、回家排序。
speaking.sample: We arrived on Friday. We stayed near the beach. We walked by the sea. We returned on Sunday.

reading.title: 用过去时讲周末旅行
reading.text: Our first day in Bath was rainy. We visited the museum in the morning and watched a film after lunch. We walked back to our hotel when the rain stopped.

questions.q: What did they do after lunch?

writing.prompt: 写 45–60 词给朋友介绍你上周末去的地方和做的两件事。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（规则动词加 -ed）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Yesterday 指已结束的时间，visit 的过去式是 visited。

quiz.prompt: What does “stay” mean in this lesson?

vocabulary.example: I bought a souvenir at the market.

listening.title: What Did You Do?
listening.transcript: I went to the night market on my first evening. I bought a postcard for my sister and took some photos of the food stalls.

speaking.prompt: 说出上次出门你去了哪、买了什么、怎样到达。
speaking.sample: I went to the old town. I took a bus and bought a postcard.

reading.title: 常见不规则过去式
reading.text: Kim went to the old town on Saturday. She took a bus to the main square and bought bread at a small bakery. She met a friend at noon.

questions.q: How did Kim get to the square?

writing.prompt: 写 50–65 词讲一次购物或参观经历，至少用三个不规则过去式。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（go → went，take → took，buy → bought）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.prompt: I ___ a photo of the bridge.

quiz.explanation: souvenir 在本课中指纪念品。
quiz.prompt: What does “souvenir” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: Did You Enjoy It?
lessons.subtitle: 用 did 追问经历
grammar: Did + 主语 + 动词原形

vocabulary.example: I bought a souvenir at the market.

listening.title: Did You Enjoy It?
listening.transcript: Did you visit the castle? Yes, I did. I went on Tuesday. Did you take the guided tour? No, I walked around with my friend.

speaking.prompt: 假装采访一位旅行者，用 Did 和 Where did 各问一句，再模拟回答。
speaking.sample: Did you visit the castle? Yes, I did. Where did you stay? I stayed near the station.

reading.title: 用 did 追问经历
reading.text: Maya asks Leo about his trip. He tells her he visited the castle but chose a free walking tour instead of the paid castle tour. He met two other travellers on the walk.

writing.prompt: 写一段 6 行采访对话，问目的地、活动和感受。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（Did + 主语 + 动词原形）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Did 已经表示过去，后面的动词用原形。

quiz.prompt: What does “trip” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: It Was Closed
lessons.subtitle: 描述意外和过去的状态
grammar: was/were 与 didn’t + 动词原形

vocabulary.example: I bought a souvenir at the market.

listening.title: It Was Closed
listening.transcript: The café was closed, so we didn’t have lunch there. We went to a place across the street. It was busy, but we found a table outside.

questions.q: Where did they find a table?

speaking.prompt: 说一次原计划没成的经历，然后交代你改做了什么。
speaking.sample: The café was closed, so we didn’t eat there. We bought lunch at the market.

reading.title: 描述意外和过去的状态
reading.text: Our train was late, and we didn’t arrive before seven. The restaurant was full, so we bought sandwiches at the station. We ate them at the hotel.

writing.prompt: 写 55–70 词解释一个旅行计划为什么改变。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（was/were 与 didn’t + 动词原形）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Didn’t 后使用动词原形 have。
closed 在本课中指关闭的。
quiz.prompt: What does “closed” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: How Was It?
lessons.subtitle: 用感受形容词描述经历
grammar: was/were + 形容词，用 because 补充理由

vocabulary.example: I was disappointed because it rained.

listening.title: How Was It?
listening.transcript: I was nervous before my first boat trip. After ten minutes I felt fine. The water was calm, and I enjoyed the view.

questions.q: How did the speaker feel before the trip?

speaking.prompt: 讲一次先紧张、后来开心的经历，解释原因。
speaking.sample: I was nervous because it was my first boat trip. I felt better after ten minutes.

reading.title: 用感受形容词描述经历
reading.text: The walk was tiring because the hill was steep. Ben was tired at the top, but he was happy with the view. He stayed for twenty minutes to take photos.

writing.prompt: 写一篇 60 词旅行短评，说清哪件事让你满意或失望。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（was/were + 形容词，用 because 补充理由）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Tiring 形容让人疲惫的事情。
quiz.prompt: The walk was ___, so I felt tired.

quiz.explanation: disappointed 在本课中指失望的。
quiz.prompt: What does “disappointed” mean in this lesson?

vocabulary.example: I was disappointed because it rained.

listening.title: First, Then, Finally
listening.transcript: First we checked the address. Then we asked a shopkeeper for help. Finally, we found the hotel behind the bus station.

speaking.prompt: 用三个连接词讲一件按顺序发生的小事。
speaking.sample: First, I checked the address. Then I asked for help. Finally, I found the hotel.

reading.title: 把旅行经历讲清楚
reading.text: We missed a bus on Sunday. First, we checked the next departure time. Then we bought coffee nearby. Finally, we caught the next bus and arrived at the museum before noon.

questions.q: What did they do between buses?

writing.prompt: 写 60–75 词复盘一次迷路或错过交通工具的经历。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（用 first、then、finally 串联事件）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Finally 在叙事中可以引出最后一步。
quiz.prompt: Which word introduces the last event?
What does “finally” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: Weekly Challenge: My Last Trip
lessons.subtitle: 用过去时讲完整旅行故事
grammar: 过去式、did 问句和时间顺序综合

vocabulary.example: I was disappointed because it rained.

listening.title: Weekly Challenge: My Last Trip
listening.transcript: I went to a mountain village last spring. The bus was late, but a passenger recommended a bakery near the stop. I tried its bread and met a local guide. That was my favourite part of the trip.

options: Trying the bread and meeting a guide
questions.answer: Trying the bread and meeting a guide

speaking.prompt: 讲一段约 90 秒的旅行回忆，包含一个意外和一个亮点，再自问自答两个问题。
speaking.sample: I went to a village last spring. The bus was late, but I found a great bakery. Did I enjoy the day? Yes, I did.

reading.title: 用过去时讲完整旅行故事
reading.text: Dear Jo, our first hike didn’t go as planned. It rained, so we visited a small museum first. Later the sky cleared. We took a short walk and saw the valley before sunset.

questions.q: What did they do when it rained?

writing.prompt: 写 80–100 词的旅行明信片，包含时间、地点、三个事件和你的感受。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（过去式、did 问句和时间顺序综合）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: memorable 在本课中指难忘的。
quiz.prompt: What does “memorable” mean in this lesson?
